legalName: Confidential Criminal History Record Information for Non-Conviction Dispositions, and the § 709 Inspection and Correction Request, 16 M.R.S. ch. 7

componentConditions.primary_filing: Sent only where the agency record is demonstrably inaccurate - most often where the State Bureau of Identification is still carrying, as public, a disposition that 16 M.R.S. Sec. 703(2) makes confidential, or is carrying a disposition that is simply wrong. Where the record is accurate, nothing is sent: the confidentiality of a Sec. 703(2) disposition is automatic.
componentConditions.attachment: Accompanies the Sec. 709 request wherever the participant holds a disposition order.

routeSelectionNote: The two units are alternatives, not stages: nothing is sent on the base branch, and the § 709 request is conditional on the agency record being demonstrably inaccurate — a condition printed on the request's own face. Which unit applies turns on what the participant's own Bureau record shows, so neither is selected for them and no route election appears on the paper.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Where the record is actually causing a problem - the Bureau record, the court docket, or a private vendor's report
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Where the record is actually causing a problem - the Bureau record, the court docket, or a private vendor's report
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the three problems have three different remedies and only the participant's own documents can say which applies
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: where the record is actually hurting you, decided after you have your own Bureau record from the State Bureau of Identification, your court paperwork from the court's records office, or the vendor's report - it decides which remedy, if any, this packet holds

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What the requester was charged with
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What the requester was charged with
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the charge, worded as your court paperwork words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The amendment or correction requested, with the Sec. 703(2) paragraph where one applies
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The amendment or correction requested, with the Sec. 703(2) paragraph where one applies
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the correction is the participant's own request, grounded on their own paperwork; the platform asserts nothing about the agency's conduct
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what the record should show instead, and - where the disposition is on the Sec. 703(2) list - which paragraph it falls under, taken from the classification worksheet

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the case ended, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the case ended, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the case ended, taken from the court order or docket entry

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the case ended, copied from the court order or docket entry, including any with-prejudice or plea-agreement wording exactly as the paperwork says
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the case ended, copied from the court order or docket entry, including any with-prejudice or plea-agreement wording exactly as the paperwork says
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the two dismissal facts decide the classification and neither can be inferred; where the order is silent the field stays blank and the participant is routed to the records office or to advice
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended, copied exactly - for a dismissal, whether it was with prejudice and whether it was outside a plea agreement decide the Sec. 703(2) classification; where your paperwork does not say, leave the line blank and ask the court's records office before sending, or get advice

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket number of the case, where the paperwork states one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket number of the case, where the paperwork states one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number, copied from your court paperwork where it states one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court that handled the case, and its county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court that handled the case, and its county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no court identity is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which court handled the case and its county, from your court paperwork; the court's records office can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What the agency record currently shows about the case, copied from the requester's own Bureau record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What the agency record currently shows about the case, copied from the requester's own Bureau record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what the agency currently carries can only come from the participant's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what your own Bureau record currently carries for this case, copied from the record itself - obtain it from the State Bureau of Identification first
